Some citizens have bypassed the censorship by using Starlink, Mr Elon Musk’s satellite internet service. Starlink is illegal in Iran, but receivers have been smuggled into the country in recent years and sold on the black market. Under a tiered access system, many government employees have been “white-listed” and are still able to use the worldwide internet during times of war or unrest, according to activists. State-run media is able to broadcast and post on social media despite the blackout. The Iranian regime has used these platforms as their main tool of communication during the war.
